name: autoselect
title: Autoselect
description: Selects the text of an autofocused field, so typing replaces the value.

attributes.name: data-autoselect
attributes.description: Selects the content when the element appears, if it also has autofocus.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: The selection happens when the field appears with autofocus, as in a dialog or a freshly loaded page.
